metadata.description: Agent skills for personal projects: pull request review verification, a single cloud entry for AWS, Google Cloud, and Cloudflare, and multi-page architecture sites for existing codebases.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Verifies pull request review findings from automated reviewers or humans before changing any code. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: cloud
plugins.description: One entry for AWS, Google Cloud, and Cloudflare: learn a service, evaluate and price options, design an architecture, and set up resources with Terraform.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Turns an existing codebase into a multi-page, diagram-led architecture site with linked diagrams and panels, conclusions only, and code line refs pinned to a commit.
